import json
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"examples/av1_dec_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"data","code":"if (size <= IVF_FILE_HDR_SZ) return 0;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are accepted as an IVF container only when the input is long enough to reach the decoder path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"examples/av1_dec_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":28,"var":"frame_size","code":"frame_size = mem_get_le32(data); frame_size = std::min(size, frame_size);","note":"Each IVF frame header supplies a frame length that determines how many bytes are passed to the AV1 decoder."},
  {"step":3,"file":"examples/av1_dec_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"err","code":"aom_codec_decode(&codec, data, frame_size, nullptr);","note":"The selected frame payload is handed to libaom for AV1 parsing and decoding."},
  {"step":4,"file":"av1/decoder/decoder.c","function":"aom_codec_decode","line":476,"var":"source","code":"aom_decode_frame_from_obus(pbi, source, source + size, psource);","note":"The decoder forwards the frame payload into the OBU-based AV1 bitstream parser."},
  {"step":5,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"aom_decode_frame_from_obus","line":898,"var":"obu_header,payload_size,bytes_read","code":"aom_read_obu_header_and_size(data, bytes_available, pbi->is_annexb, &obu_header, &payload_size, &bytes_read);","note":"The parser reads the attacker-controlled OBU header and payload length from the frame bytes."},
  {"step":6,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"aom_decode_frame_from_obus","line":933,"var":"obu_header.type","code":"switch (obu_header.type)","note":"The OBU type steers execution into the frame/tile-group decoding path that processes coded tile data."},
  {"step":7,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"aom_decode_frame_from_obus","line":1027,"var":"decoded_payload_size","code":"decoded_payload_size += read_one_tile_group_obu(... data + obu_payload_offset, data + payload_size, ...);","note":"Tile-group bytes are decoded using offsets derived from the attacker-controlled frame structure."},
  {"step":8,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_one_tile_group_obu","line":361,"var":"data","code":"av1_decode_tg_tiles_and_wrapup(pbi, data, data_end, p_data_end, start_tile, end_tile, is_first_tg);","note":"The tile-group payload is decoded into the current frame buffer, establishing the state used by later tile-list handling."},
  {"step":9,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"aom_decode_frame_from_obus","line":1059,"var":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","code":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list(pbi, &rb, data, data + payload_size, p_data_end, &frame_decoding_finished);","note":"For large-scale tile coding, the decoder enters the tile-list path that copies decoded tiles into a separate output buffer."},
  {"step":10,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"read_and_decode_one_tile_list","line":560,"var":"tile_idx","code":"copy_decoded_tile_to_tile_list_buffer(pbi, tile_idx);","note":"Each tile entry triggers a copy from the decoded frame into the tile-list output buffer using dimensions and indices read from the bitstream."},
  {"step":11,"file":"av1/decoder/obu.c","function":"copy_decoded_tile_to_tile_list_buffer","line":465,"var":"cur_frame->buffers[plane]","code":"aom_yv12_partial_copy_y(cur_frame, hstart1, hend1, vstart1, vend1, &pbi->tile_list_outbuf, hstart2, vstart2);","note":"The copy helper reads from the source frame buffer; the vulnerable candidate is a crafted tile-list/frame combination that makes this read run past the allocated source buffer, producing the heap-buffer-overflow READ 8."}
]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc.ivf /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true
